_comment: What it costs an Age's instability budget to be set alight (design 5.0, 5.2).
Difficulty you can answer: fire goes out in rain by vanilla's own rule, so an inflicted inferno in a
wet Age is a nuisance and in a dry one is a siege -- and which of those it is falls out of the Age's
own climate rather than out of anything written here.
One step, where the other phenomena have a ramp: what a written inferno does is a fact about the sun
rather than a dial, so this either happens or it does not. A ramp would have to be designed in
`Inferno.burn` before it could be priced here. Opens at 16 with the other phenomena.
